name: Master’s Voice [Psionic]
body:
You are always present in the mind of your thrall.

Prerequisite: Thrallherd class feature

Benefit: Each of your thralls is always under the effect of a permanent mindlink with you. You can always communicate instantly with them and you do not need to spend power points to manifest this power.
